strategy.phase: first-sales-60d: no new products, only sales + reviews
rules: No new product creation until phase_until. Proposals for new products go to decisions as 'backlog', not to the queue.
Etsy storefront shows max 5 focus products; everything else stays draft/inactive until the first 10 sales.
Pinterest is the only growth channel: 10-15 fresh pins per week, all pointing to focus products or KDP books.
Instagram: 2 Reels per week max, cut from existing OpenArt/YouTube clips. No new OpenArt credits without approval.
YouTube: Shorts only from existing videos. No new songs this phase.
Money decisions (price change, ad budget change, hiding a listing, any spend) always need Nick's approval via email reply 'approve D-xxxxxx'.
Content (pins, posts, reels, shorts) publishes automatically without approval.
Paused until January: Trendyol, website work, new personalized books, Spanish dictionary, extra YouTube channels.

decisions.proposal: Etsy storefront down to 5 focus products (5-in-1 Christmas bundle, Montessori Life Skills, Toddler Busy Book, 1 personalized Christmas book, Winter Science Lab). All other listings set to inactive (not deleted) until 10 sales.
decisions.why: 0 sales at ~400 views/day = conversion problem; fewer, stronger listings

decisions.proposal: Focus prices: bundle $9.99, Montessori $7.99, Busy Book $7.99, Winter Lab $6.99, personalized book $29.99. Run a 30% launch sale for 14 days to get the first 10 sales + reviews, then back to list price.
decisions.why: cheapest listing signals low quality; a time-boxed sale buys sales velocity

decisions.proposal: Etsy Ads $4/day for 14 days on the 5 focus products only. Amazon Ads: add a $5/day Auto campaign for My First Pencil Control Book (bilingual niche).
decisions.why: zero-sales shops do not rank organically; small paid velocity first

decisions.proposal: Ask 10 friends/family/Turkish school parents to buy the $2-3 sale-priced digital bundle and leave a review this week.
decisions.why: reviews are the biggest missing trust signal
